source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Gather relevant data from contractors and employees.
3. Document non-compliance findings.
4. Inspect staff training records for adequacy.
5. Note any prior warnings or violations.
6. Record environmental or safety testing results, if relevant.
7. Include details of any incidents or near-incidents.
8. Photograph and document any unsafe conditions.
9. Evaluate the effectiveness of the safety management system.
10. Compare against industry standards and regulations.
11. Compile witness statements and interviews where needed.
12. Record corrective actions taken or recommended.
13. Summarize your findings in a detailed report.
14. Provide a timeline for follow-up and further action.
15. Maintain records securely for potential legal or compliance review.
16. Keep a log of communication with regulatory agencies, if any.
17. Follow up with site management to ensure understanding of findings.
18. File the audit report according to company protocol.
19. Review the documentation periodically to monitor compliance progress
